description:
What every settled match paid, and to whom.

Free on purpose. A claim about where the money went that costs money to
check is not a claim anybody should believe.

Sorted and paged by the SERVER. This is the one table that grows without
bound — a row per settled match, kept when everything else about the match
is purged — so sending all of it and cutting it up in the browser has an end
date. `total` comes back with the page so a reader knows how much there is.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

page.description: Which page of settled matches, from 0.

page_size.description: How many settled matches per page.
